note: Other outlets' counts for the night (scripts/live/outlets.py). An outlet is read once its url is set; until then it is ignored. The poller re-reads these settings every 5 minutes, first from 'remote' (this file on the repository's night branch: changing it there doesn't redeploy the site), then from this local copy. 'off': true turns one off without deleting it.

outlets.label: 中央社
outlets.where: 2022: https://www.cna.com.tw/project/20221126-election-live/api/city.json (the 2026 page would be project/20261128-election-live/; in 2022 and 2024 it went up 3 days before the vote)

outlets.label: 公視（中選會資料）
outlets.where: The CEC's media feed as 公視 republished it. 2022: https://d3prffu8f9hpuw.cloudfront.net/campaign-2022/assets/data/final.json is the end-of-night copy; the file read during the count had another name (look at the page's network requests on the night). 2024 used one file per county: news.pts.org.tw/projects/2024-election-vote/vote/p1-63-000.json. Used only as a fallback for the CEC's own numbers.

outlets.label: 電視台
outlets.where: 公視 2024: https://news.pts.org.tw/projects/2024-election-vote/tv/latest.json (TV channels' on-screen counts). The 2022 local-election page had no TV counts.

outlets.label: 自由時報
outlets.where: 2022: election.ltn.com.tw/2022/realtime/<city> showed 東森, 民視, 台視 and the CEC side by side. 2026 pages would be election.ltn.com.tw/2026/realtime/...; a url with {en} or {code} is filled in per race. The site blocks some automated reading; if it does, leave this off.

outlets.label: 聯合報
outlets.where: udn.com/vote2026/ (即時選情 tab). Format unknown until the night.
